name: SEO Auditor Tools
author: Fernando Fas

sections.description:
SEO Auditor Tools is a lightweight, all-in-one SEO toolkit for WordPress.

Beyond auditing, the plugin packs a full collection of everyday SEO tools — all from a single dashboard with no bloat:

Free Tools Included

  • SEO Audit Dashboard — Crawl up to 10 front-end pages and get a scored SEO report with actionable issue cards, severity levels, and plain-language fixes.
  • Open Graph & Meta Description — Set global OG title, description, image, and fallback meta description. Includes a Meta Tag Analyzer and OG Checker.
  • Per-Page Meta Description — Override the global meta description on any post or page via the block editor sidebar.
  • Sitemap Generator — One-click XML sitemap with a visual page list.
  • Robots.txt Editor — Edit or regenerate robots.txt with live preview.
  • LLMS.txt Generator — Create an llms.txt file at your site root for AI crawlers.
  • Cookie Consent Banner — GDPR-friendly accept/reject banner with custom message, colours, and positioning.
  • Google Analytics & Tag Manager — Paste your GA or GTM snippet and it is injected into the head automatically.
  • IndexNow — Automatically ping Bing, Yandex, and other search engines when content changes.
  • UTM Campaign Builder — Build UTM-tagged URLs and copy them in one click.
  • QR Code Generator — Create QR codes for any URL, download as PNG or copy as Base64.
  • Settings Export — Export all plugin settings as JSON or CSV for reuse on another site.

Why Upgrade to Pro?

SEO Auditor Tools Pro unlocks the full power of the audit engine and adds advanced tools:

  • Unlimited page audits — Scan your entire site (Pro default: 200 pages, configurable).
  • Full 4-category scoring — SEO, Accessibility, Performance, and Best Practices with detailed issue breakdowns for every category.
  • PageSpeed Insights integration — Pull live Lighthouse scores into your dashboard.
  • PDF audit export — Download a branded PDF report for clients or stakeholders.
  • Per-page keywords & robots directives — Control meta keywords, noindex, and nofollow per post/page.
  • Advanced cookie consent — Granular analytics and marketing cookie default toggles.
  • Custom tracking scripts — Additional head and body script injection beyond GA/GTM.
  • Security Monitor — File integrity checks, login hardening, header security.
  • Image Tools — Bulk add missing dimensions, regenerate thumbnails, non-destructive editing.
  • Cache & Minify Tools — Page caching, HTML/CSS/JS minification.
  • .htaccess Editor — Safe editing with backup/restore.
  • Redirection Manager — 301/302 redirects with first-login redirect support.
  • AI Chatbot — On-site AI assistant for visitors.
  • Product Schema — Structured data for WooCommerce products.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following third-party services:

QR Server (api.qrserver.com)

Used by the QR Code Generator tool to create QR code images on demand. When a user generates a QR code, the target URL is sent to the QR Server API and an image is returned.

  • Service URL: https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/
  • Terms of Use: https://goqr.me/api/
  • Privacy Policy: https://goqr.me/de/rechtliches/datenschutz-goqrme.html

Data sent: the URL you enter in the QR code generator. No personal data is transmitted.

IndexNow (api.indexnow.org)

Used by the IndexNow feature to notify Bing, Yandex, and other search engines when content is published or updated. This feature is opt-in and disabled by default.

  • Service URL: https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow
  • Terms of Use: https://www.indexnow.org/faq
  • Privacy Policy: https://privacy.microsoft.com/en-us/privacystatement

Data sent: the public URL of the updated page and your IndexNow API key. No personal data is transmitted.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the seo-auditor-tools folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through Plugins → Installed Plugins.
  3. Go to SEO Auditor Tools → Dashboard and click Run Audit to scan your site.
sections.faq:
How many pages can I audit?

The Lite version audits up to 10 front-end pages. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited audits.

Does this plugin slow down my site?

No. The audit runs on-demand in the admin area. Front-end output is limited to the cookie banner and analytics snippets — both lightweight.

Is the cookie banner GDPR compliant?

The banner provides accept/reject functionality with optional cookie preferences. You are responsible for ensuring your overall site complies with applicable privacy regulations.

Can I use this alongside other SEO plugins?

Yes. SEO Auditor Tools focuses on auditing and tooling rather than rewriting your entire meta output, so it works well alongside Yoast, Rank Math, or others.

1.1.0

  • Initial release of SEO Auditor Tools for WordPress.org.
  • SEO audit with 10-page limit and scored dashboard.
  • Open Graph, sitemap, robots.txt, LLMS.txt generators.
  • Cookie consent banner with accept/reject.
  • Google Analytics and Tag Manager injection.
  • IndexNow automatic pinging.
  • UTM builder and QR code generator.
  • Settings export (JSON/CSV).
  • Pro upgrade banners with link to seoauditor.one.
